brief.note: Prices are Friday's close. A hawkish Fed hold and AI-spending fears drove last week's selloff.

candidates.name: Lennox International
candidates.business: Designs and makes heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration equipment
candidates.cause: Cut 2026 EPS guidance to $23.00-$24.00, a 4.7% miss on the midpoint, as residential HVAC demand stayed weak. Commercial held up and revenue growth was reaffirmed.
candidates.right: Residential HVAC demand turns before the commercial side softens.
candidates.wrong: Housing stays weak into 2027 and this cut is the first of several.

candidates.name: Roblox
candidates.business: Runs an online platform where users build and play each other's games
candidates.cause: Revenue missed at $1.47bn against $1.6bn expected, third-quarter bookings were guided down 14-18% year on year, and management withdrew annual guidance.
candidates.right: Spending per user stabilises and management restores annual guidance.
candidates.wrong: Bookings keep shrinking and the decline in spending per user proves structural.

candidates.name: Corning
candidates.business: Makes specialty glass and optical fibre for displays, telecoms and data centres
candidates.cause: Guided current-quarter revenue to $4.9-5.0bn against $5.0bn consensus despite beating on Q2, triggering its worst day since 2002 as money rotated out of AI infrastructure.
candidates.right: Data-centre demand for optical fibre keeps compounding into next year.
candidates.wrong: The AI infrastructure trade keeps unwinding from a still-rich multiple.
